yes_definition: Yes requires a representative measurement within the construct and timing boundaries, controlled through the selected model or a qualifying design. Record the variable, timing, control method and source evidence.
no_definition: No requires a complete model specification showing no qualifying coverage. Missing reporting alone is insufficient.
uncertainty_policy: Assign a grade only when all admissible Yes/No assignments yield the same result; otherwise mark the record for verification. Verification pending and exclusion are processing statuses.
path_screen: Report-only diagnostic. Other construct conditioning and opened paths do not trigger B4 exclusion or an automatic downgrade.
alternative_set_policy: Accept complete coverage of any enumerated graph-valid minimal adjustment set; both sets must be checked in full. Do not combine incomplete fragments or mix models, outcomes, or time windows.
scope: Model-level reported construct coverage, conditional on the working DAG; not overall risk of bias or proof that residual confounding is absent.
exclusion_policy: Exclude an estimate if and only if the selected model conditions on any of C14, C16 or C17.
conditioning_definition: Actual adjustment, stratification, matching, weighting or sample restriction on the defined construct; measurement or discussion alone does not trigger exclusion.
b4_pass_meaning: The model does not condition on C14/C16/C17 under the recorded mapping. Passing B4 does not establish sufficient adjustment or absence of collider or other bias.
pilot_mapping_policy: Ratings use the recorded selected-model controls, with timing and design assumptions documented for each model.
scientific_scope: The fixed exclusion set defines this appraisal. Adjustment involving other constructs requires separate evaluation.
overall_rule: After B4: Strong if the covered construct set contains all members of A or all members of B; otherwise Weak if any reference domain is Weak; otherwise Moderate.
domain_rule: B1-B3 remain fixed-reference domain coverage diagnostics under set A. Domain grades do not substitute for the explicit whole-set test. A model meeting set B may be Overall Strong with reference B2 Moderate.
superset_scope: This is minimum-set construct coverage under the adopted B4 screen. It does not assert that every larger actual adjustment set is graph-valid or bias-free.

C13_coverage_rule.eligible: A current-pregnancy obstetric condition documented as present before the start of the selected exposure window and actually controlled in the selected model. It must represent the antecedent component assumed by the graph, without being caused by earlier target exposure.
C13_coverage_rule.ineligible: Gestational age at birth, preterm birth, birthweight, small-for-gestational-age status, delivery or labour mode, birth trauma, Apgar scores and other delivery/neonatal outcomes do not establish antecedent C13 coverage.
C13_coverage_rule.timing_unresolved: Pregnancy-wide diagnoses of gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia or other complications without onset ordering are Unclear for C13 coverage. Actual reported controls remain recorded. Unclear is an input-evidence status, not a fourth grade.
C13_coverage_rule.exposure_anchor: Use the start of the exposure window represented by the selected contrast; specimen collection at delivery does not by itself establish the beginning of prenatal exposure.
C13_coverage_rule.output_rule: Recalculate the tree under all admissible C13 Yes/No assignments. Assign a grade only if every assignment gives the same grade. The C14/C16/C17 exclusion rule is unchanged.
C13_coverage_rule.graph_scope: Set B requires an antecedent C13 component consistent with the adopted 132-edge graph.
